children: Profound Medical’s revenue rose 86% year over year, while its net loss narrowed 3%. Higher capital equipment sales in the U.S. and overseas drove revenue growth; gross margin increased to 78% from 74%, while operating expenses rose 21%.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributed to shareholders for the period”. ³ Reported as “Basic and diluted net loss per common share”.
: Capital equipment revenue increased to $5.7M from $1.2M, driven by higher sales overseas and in the U.S.
: Recurring non-capital revenue was $4.1M, compared with $4.1M a year earlier.
: Gross margin rose to 78% from 74%; gross profit increased 95% to $7.7M as more capital systems were sold.
: R&D expenses increased 7% to $5.8M, reflecting higher personnel, travel, consulting and material costs for product and supply-chain initiatives.
